page.overview:
Who is Chambray D’Axauex?

Chambray D'Axauex, the "Lioness of Couronne," was the Duchess of Couronne in Bretonnia during the reign of King Louen Orc-Slayer in the late tenty-third century IC. Though Couronne was the traditional seat of the Royarch of Bretonnia, the king ruled instead from Bastonne, sp D'Axauex continued to rule her home dukedom, priding herself on the martial prowess of her subjects.
